key.name: enabled-providers
key.description: Provider adapters shown in the panel popup. Each value is a collector provider id.

key.name: selected-provider
key.description: Provider shown first in the popup and used for the panel percentage label.

key.name: panel-label
key.description: What the top-panel button shows: icon-percent, icon, or hidden (auto-hide is separate).

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often provider snapshots regenerate automatically. Range 60 to 3600.

key.name: auto-hide
key.summary: Hide the panel button when there is no data
key.description: When enabled, the indicator hides itself while no enabled provider has any usage or limits.

key.name: claude-dir
key.description: Custom Claude config directory. Empty means CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR or ~/.claude. No secrets belong here.

key.name: codex-home
key.description: Custom Codex home directory. Empty means CODEX_HOME or ~/.codex.

key.name: codex-executable
key.description: Custom codex binary path for the rate-limit probe. Empty means lookup on PATH.
